title: FBI Photo A005
what_is_it: A UAP still image (photograph) submitted to AARO by the FBI, with an accompanying narrative description but no mission report.
interpretation_warnings: No source text could be extracted from the file; all facts are drawn from metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
Date and location of the event are unknown, so the image cannot be independently corroborated.
Imagery was redacted before submission, so context may be missing.
The narrative description is explicitly not an analytical judgement or factual determination about the object's nature.
Single-source report; the operator themselves could not identify the object.
